---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for CadenzaOS
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you are proposing.

## Motivation
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve, or what capability
does it add? Please explain the use case rather than just the solution.

## Proposed Approach
If you have an idea of how this could be implemented, describe it here.
For features touching the scheduler, memory management, filesystem, or
syscall interface, please think through the architectural implications and
note any concerns.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative approaches? Why is your proposed
approach preferable?

## Scope
Which parts of the codebase would this affect?
[ ] Bootloader
[ ] Kernel core (scheduler, memory, interrupts)
[ ] Filesystem (CodaFS)
[ ] Shell / commands
[ ] Syscall interface
[ ] External binary programs
[ ] Build system
[ ] Documentation
[ ] Other (describe)

## Are you willing to implement this?
[ ] Yes, I would like to implement this myself
[ ] I would need guidance to implement this
[ ] I am requesting this for someone else to implement

## Additional Context
Any other information, references, or examples that would help understand
the feature request.
